chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Ch. 107: The Exorcism Begins with an Eyeball Graft and a Fly Buddha
chapter_meta_description: Abbess Jingxin grafts blood-red eyeballs into her sockets. Six obese nuns roll out on carts. A giant Buddha made of flies buzzes in the pit. The exorcism of Danyangzi finally begins in the most grotesque way possible.
og_title: The Exorcism Begins with a Fly Buddha
og_description: Li Huowang watches a blind nun slam bloody eyeballs into her own face. The ritual to expel Danyangzi is about to start—and it’s already horrifying.
twitter_title: A Fly Buddha and a Nun’s New Eyes: Chapter 107
twitter_description: The exorcism ritual starts, and the first thing that happens is an old nun ripping open her own eye sockets. Li Huowang trusts her anyway.
